A real phase-vortex field, draped classically over a real cortical surface

Every vertex position, triangle, winding number, and phase angle here is read directly from outputs/pitnn_cohort/ds005620/subjects/*.json. The scalp shell's color field is a skyrmion-style rendering convention — blue/red for the two signs of real winding, arrows for real phase angle — applied to genuine discrete EEG topology, not to a physical spin texture. Underneath it sits a real FreeSurfer fsaverage5 cortical surface, draped in the classical EEG/fMRI heat-map style with that same real winding data, interpolated by electrode angle. Drag to orbit; scrub the slider to morph between the two real measured states and watch the same fixed real geometry's vortices appear, flip sign, and fade.

What is derived, not measured: electrode depth (z) is reconstructed by projecting each subject's real 2D sensor coordinates onto a sphere fit to their own electrode extent — a standard scalp-surface convention, the geometric inverse of the flattening MNE itself performs for 2D topomaps — not measured 3D position. Per-vertex color on the scalp shell is triangle windings averaged onto their shared vertices for a smooth field, not a new measurement. The brain surface is FreeSurfer's real, standard fsaverage5 group-average template (via the nilearn-bundled pial_left/right.gii.gz, curvature-shaded with its own real sulcal curvature) — it is not this subject's, or any individual's, anatomy, and this pipeline has no MRI or source-localization step for ds005620. The heat-map draped on it is real per-electrode winding magnitude, spherically interpolated onto the template surface by electrode angle (nearest-5, inverse-distance weighted) — a classical-topomap-style visualization, not a computed source estimate. The awake↔sedated slider linearly interpolates between exactly two real recordings; it is not continuous measured dynamics.

Run per subject via scripts/run_empirical_falsification.py: verdict NOT_SUPPORTED in 20 / 20 subjects, Bayes factor range 0.9999993–0.9999999 (PASS requires K > 100). The vortex field above is a real, measured description of the gamma-band phase topology — it is not evidence for the theory that motivated measuring it.

Source: outputs/pitnn_cohort/ds005620/subjects/*.json, produced by tools/stream_pitnn_cohort_ds005620.py --export-spatial --export-persistence and reported in full in REPORT_ds005620_pitnn_cohort_topology.md.

  • Real, unmodified: electrode (x, y), triangle indices, per-triangle winding number, per-channel phase, H1 birth/death pairs, bottleneck distances, all cohort statistics; the fsaverage5 cortical surface and its sulcal curvature (FreeSurfer standard template, via nilearn — tools/export_fsaverage5_for_vortex_field.py).
  • Derived for display only, disclosed above: electrode z (sphere projection), per-vertex smoothed winding (color), tangent-frame arrow direction, awake↔sedated slider interpolation, particle motion (deterministically seeded, cosmetic only), the electrode-angle interpolation draping real winding magnitude onto the template cortex (classical topomap style, not a source estimate), and the cortex's alignment/scale/nesting inside the electrode sphere.
These are descriptive EEG network measures. They are not a measure of awareness, dreaming, or consciousness.
